info.title: Mercenta API — Mainnet release contract
info.description: Mainnet domain is a read-only preview on Arc chain 5042. Real purchases, deposits, agent execution and wallet sessions are CLOSED. Requests are never forwarded to the testnet account backend. The inherited paths describe the intended surface, not enabled real buying. A production checkout contract must be finalized before activation.

get.description: Public catalogue metadata. Prices are indicative USD, not payment quotes. Responses may be cached snapshots. Query id returns a product, view=browse returns compact tuples.
